rules.name: version_and_payload_coherence
rules.symptom: The old 1.1.0 archive did not contain the latest packaging QA script and prevention rules.
rules.root_cause: The archive was treated as the source of truth even though development continued after it was built.
rules.prevention: Build only from current source, require one release version across plugin/API/build script, and verify every staged file through integration-manifest.json and SHA256SUMS.

rules.name: self_contained_test_fixtures
rules.symptom: Clean-source tests failed because they read plans from jobs and research experiment directories.
rules.root_cause: Regression inputs were referenced by convenient workspace paths instead of being owned by the test suite.
rules.prevention: Every release test must use a minimal sanitized fixture under its own tests/fixtures directory; jobs and research/experiments are forbidden dependencies.

rules.name: preview_acceptance_matches_delivery_contract
rules.symptom: A valid white PNG with manually verified Chinese text was rejected because an optional pathized SVG had no native text elements.
rules.root_cause: The validator required every supplied preview format to pass a format-specific text check instead of applying the at-least-one delivery contract.
rules.prevention: Accept at least one structurally viewable preview plus a recorded original-resolution visual inspection; treat pathized SVG as optional auxiliary evidence.

rules.name: verification_must_not_pollute_release
rules.symptom: Running Python tests after staging created __pycache__ files in the verification directory.
rules.root_cause: The verification command used Python's default bytecode-writing behavior inside the release tree.
rules.prevention: Set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 for the entire verification process tree because python -B does not propagate to child interpreters; then verify cache absence and hashes without mutating the archive.

rules.name: proprietary_host_binaries_are_local_only
rules.symptom: A complete local SolidWorks host bundle included vendor interop DLLs whose redistribution rights were not established.
rules.root_cause: Installability and distributability were treated as the same property.
rules.prevention: Publish host source and build instructions by default; exclude SolidWorks interop DLLs and executables unless an explicit redistribution license is recorded.

rules.name: host_discovery_is_execution_only
rules.symptom: GitHub Actions could not compile a 3D plan with execute=false because the runner had no SolidWorks template.
rules.root_cause: Host template discovery ran before the execute flag was honored, and the developer workstation masked the coupling.
rules.prevention: Pure validation and compile-only paths must not probe native hosts; discover templates and executables only inside execute=true, and test with both probes forced to None.

rules.name: runtime_capabilities_match_packaged_payload
rules.symptom: The integration manifest listed packaging dieline QA, but the runtime capabilities response omitted that capability.
rules.root_cause: Static release metadata and the callable runtime capability surface were updated independently.
rules.prevention: Cross-test every advertised tool and capability against files in the packaged payload and fail the release when either side is missing.

rules.name: behavioral_tests_gate_repository_upload
rules.symptom: Manifest and SHA256 verification passed while four runtime behavior tests still failed.
rules.root_cause: Structural package integrity was treated as sufficient evidence of functional readiness.
rules.prevention: Require the core suite, plugin regression suite, Codex manifest validation and release hash verification to all pass before source staging, commit, tag or upload.

rules.name: remote_baseline_preflight
rules.symptom: A locally rebuilt package would have lowered the Agent API version and removed compatibility fields that were already present on the remote main branch.
rules.root_cause: The release source tree was staged before fetching and comparing the existing remote default branch.
rules.prevention: Fetch and diff the remote default branch before packaging; fail when a candidate lowers versions, removes capability fields or changes public CLI flags without an explicit reviewed migration.

rules.name: immutable_versioned_release_artifacts
rules.symptom: The candidate changed the SHA256 of the already published 1.2.1 ZIP while keeping the same versioned filename.
rules.root_cause: Patch-level QA and release-rule changes were packaged without advancing the release version.
rules.prevention: If a versioned artifact or tag already exists remotely, any byte change requires the next semantic version and a new tag; never replace a published version with a different hash.

rules.name: marketplace_install_is_runtime_self_contained
rules.symptom: A Git marketplace install passed manifest validation but isolated behavior tests failed because the installed plugin had no runtime/src/aicad package.
rules.root_cause: The ZIP builder assembled the core runtime, while the Git marketplace builder copied the unassembled source template; the two distribution paths were not behaviorally equivalent.
rules.prevention: Populate the Git marketplace from the fully assembled and hash-verified release directory, require runtime/src/aicad/engine.py plus release manifests, and run the complete plugin suite from a real remote-tag installation without repository src on sys.path before publishing.

rules.name: git_checkout_preserves_manifest_bytes
rules.symptom: A real Windows Git marketplace install passed behavior tests but every text-file manifest hash failed after LF was normalized to CRLF.
rules.root_cause: The repository published byte-level release hashes without a .gitattributes policy fixing text line endings across checkout environments.
rules.prevention: Canonicalize every assembled text file to LF before hashing, publish .gitattributes with text files fixed to LF and binary overrides, then require release-hash verification inside a real remote-tag installation before publishing.

rules.name: clean_environment_dependency_closure
rules.symptom: GitHub Actions passed core tests but plugin schema tests failed with ModuleNotFoundError for jsonschema.
rules.root_cause: A directly imported third-party package was absent from the release requirements, while the developer machine supplied it implicitly and masked the missing dependency.
rules.prevention: Declare every non-standard-library import in the appropriate release requirements and third-party notices, install only those declarations in a clean environment, and require the complete suite to pass there before build, tag or upload.

rules.name: reference_preview_encoding_and_layout_are_browser_verified
rules.symptom: A mathematically correct preview shipped with mojibake, a distorted SVG aspect ratio, or labels overlapping after real font rendering.
rules.root_cause: Source UTF-8 validity, SVG coordinate geometry, and browser font metrics were treated as one inferred property instead of independent gates.
rules.prevention: Reject UTF-8 replacement/private-use characters in release text; preserve SVG viewBox aspect ratio; require source text/position/rotation evidence, bounded collision offsets, and a real-browser opaque-background, Chinese-visibility, overlap, mojibake, and console-error report before presenting a reference preview.

rules.name: host_test_resolves_command_to_executable_path
rules.symptom: The real AutoCAD host test compiled its plans but stopped before launching AutoCAD because Resolve-Path treated the command name python as a literal file in the workspace.
rules.root_cause: Get-Command had already resolved the executable, but the harness discarded that result and attempted filesystem resolution on the original command token.
rules.prevention: When a host harness accepts either an executable path or a PATH command, use Resolve-Path only for an existing file and otherwise use the Source returned by Get-Command; exercise the default command-name path in the real-host regression.

rules.name: installed_package_integrity_is_immutable
rules.symptom: The installed plugin passed all behavior tests but failed release verification because the installer changed plugin.json after copying the signed package.
rules.root_cause: A cache-busting build suffix was written into the installed manifest without atomically updating the integration manifest and SHA256SUMS.
rules.prevention: A production installer must copy the versioned package byte-for-byte and preserve all manifest hashes; same-version development cache busting is a separate workflow and must never silently mutate a verified release install.

rules.name: installed_payload_is_manifest_allowlisted
rules.symptom: A verified release directory accumulated __pycache__ files during tests and the installer copied those unlisted caches into the user plugin directory.
rules.root_cause: The installer copied the source directory recursively instead of treating integration-manifest.json as the installation allowlist.
rules.prevention: Install only files declared by integration-manifest.json plus the manifest and SHA256SUMS; reject unsafe paths and verify the installed tree so caches and temporary files cannot cross the release boundary.

rules.name: runtime_fallback_paths_are_environment_derived
rules.symptom: Release verification rejected a runtime compatibility fallback because it embedded a C:\Users\... absolute path pattern.
rules.root_cause: A portable public-directory fallback was implemented as a literal Windows absolute path instead of deriving it from the runtime environment.
rules.prevention: Resolve platform fallbacks from environment variables or system-root path components, scan every release text file for personal absolute-path patterns, and fail before packaging.
